EmailTemplate.description: Financial Aid template for CAP Benefits Eligible Missing Fafsa
EmailTemplate.name: Case Management CAP Benefits Eligible Missing FAFSA
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Our records indicate that you are ineligible to participate in the Starbucks College Achievement Plan because you have not completed a FAFSA for this year. To remain eligible to participate in the program, you’ll need to complete a FAFSA for each new academic year.
You can start your FAFSA at https://fafsa.ed.gov. Make sure to send it to ASU (federal school code 001081.) If you have questions or need assistance, reply to this email or call Financial Aid and Scholarship Services at 480-965-3200.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Financial Aid and Scholarship Services Arizona State University PO Box 870412 Tempe, AZ 85287-0412 Phone: 1-844-278-6693
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
